mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening economic activity, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6% signals labor market weakness, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings and higher default risk.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises above 6% but S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.5% signals monetary tightening, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher discount rates and lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 5.5% but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of those instances.
